weekly.overview: This week invites you to release what no longer serves your vibe. Venus is nudging you toward authenticity, so lean into conversations that feel real. Trust your gut—it's been lowkey accurate lately, and this energy rewards those who listen.
weekly.love: Whether you're single or coupled up, vulnerability is your superpower rn. If there's something you've been holding back, the cosmic timing feels right to share it. Expect deeper connections or at least some honest conversations that shift the energy.
weekly.career: Your creative instincts are sharp this week—don't sleep on those random ideas popping into your head. This is peak energy for pitching, proposing, or pivoting your approach to something that's felt stale. Your confidence has a natural magnetism others will notice.
weekly.health: Your body's asking for gentleness and consistency over intensity. Think quality over quantity with movement and rest. Pay attention to what actually makes you feel good, not what you think you should be doing. Your intuition knows what you need.
